nonBlockingIssues.description: Sphere::create_from_verts now heap-allocates a Vec<Vec3> to convert &[f32; 3] to &[Vec3] for the shared compute_bounds helper. Minor perf cost for hot paths but dedup benefit outweighs it.
Plane::transform falls back to the original (untransformed) normal when the inverse transpose computation fails (singular matrix). Caller has no way to know the normal wasn't transformed.
